# INCIDENT / OFFENSE REPORT - OAKRIDGE POLICE DEPARTMENT
Case Number: 26-04188

## INCIDENT OVERVIEW
| Field | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Incident Type | Burglary - Commercial (Forced Entry) |
| Date / Time Reported | 03/14/2026 03:42 |
| Location | 1404 Industrial Blvd, Oakridge, WA |
| Business Name | Harbor Point Tool & Rental |
| Reporting Party | Lucas Thornton (Facility Manager) |
| Investigating Officer | Officer D. Briggs #412 |

## STOLEN PROPERTY LOG
| Item # | Description | Serial Number | Stated Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | DeWalt Rotary Laser Level | DW079LR-8821 | $850.00 |
| 2 | Milwaukee MX Fuel Breaker | MXF368-1044 | $2,400.00 |
| 3 | Stihl TS 420 Concrete Saw | 189442019 | $1,250.00 |

## NARRATIVE
On 03/14/2026 at approximately 03:45 hours, I was dispatched to 1404 Industrial Blvd for an audible commercial alarm. Upon arrival at 03:49 hours, I observed pry marks on the south pedestrian access door and found the deadbolt sheared.

While clearing the interior, I heard engine noises along the eastern fence line. I moved to the rear perimeter and observed a white Ford F-250 pickup bearing WA plate CDE-4410 parked near a cut in the chain-link barrier. A male suspect wearing a navy hooded jacket fled north on foot into the wooded ravine. Suspect eluded apprehension.

In the open bed of the pickup truck, I located several recently loaded tools matching inventory missing from the display racks. Specifically, I secured a Makita Rotary Laser Level bearing serial number DW079LR-8821, one Milwaukee breaker, and one Stihl concrete saw.

Evidence tech arrived on scene at 04:15 hours to process footwear impressions and collect latent prints from the truck cab. All three items listed in the property log were successfully recovered and returned to inventory, so total financial loss from stolen property is zero, leaving no grounds for felony property offense charges. Latent lift cards were booked into Evidence Locker B under property barcode 8812.
